scripts.build:screensaver: npm run generate:population-contract && vite build --config apps/screensaver-web/vite.config.mjs && node tools/release/screensaver-scripts/prepare-dist.mjs
scripts.test:monorepo: npm run test:population-contract && npm run test:screensaver && npm run test:native-smoke
scripts.build:native:windows: npm run build:screensaver && npm run sync:native-assets && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/native/windows/build.ps1
scripts.build:native:macos: npm run build:screensaver && npm run sync:native-assets && bash apps/native/macos/build.sh
